Independent newly coded complete enumeration of all 2^14 Fano incidence masks and exchange BFS
correctness.rationale: The standard Fano incidence graph has fourteen vertices; secure(s) is exactly domination plus a selected adjacent defender for each omitted vertex whose replacement preserves domination. A fresh independent 16,384-mask exhaustive enumeration found zero secure sets below six, 84 size-six minima, and a 3-point/3-line/two-incidence characterization for every mask up to six. A noncollinear Fano triple (28 choices) has three lines meeting it once and exactly one avoiding it; choose two of those three, giving 84 configurations. GL3(F2) transitively permutes ordered bases with a distinguished line, yielding one orbit. Explicit exchange mask adjacency by symmetric difference of two bits yields 84 vertices, 168 edges, degree four, connected BFS layers (1,4,8,16,28,22,4,1), and via transitivity every eccentricity seven. An independent C++ checker exists in frozen source but was not relied upon as a log. Full enumeration is exhaustive only for THIS 14-vertex graph, not a statement for general projective planes.
residual_risks: The complete 14-vertex computation is exhaustive, but the orbit/diameter conclusion is specific to Heawood.
Publication requires privacy sanitization of metadata files.

evidence: Graph general bounds such as gamma_s≤n/2 give at most 7 for a 14-vertex graph, while the finding is 6 with 84 minima.
